3.english_title: A Charge To Keep I Have

verses.text:

4.dangme_title: Nyɔmtsɛ Ɔ Ji Ye Nɔ Hyɛlɔ

verses.text:

Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ ni tsumi he wam',
Blɔ ɔ tokofii ɔ nɔ, nyɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba,
De blɔ nyɛɛlɔ ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba gbo.

43.chorus:
Nyɛ he a yi wa nam', nyɛ juɛ a gbenɔ he,
Yesu mɔbɔ nalɔ ma he yi wam'.

44.dangme_title: Wa Tsɛ Mɔbɔ Nam' Ngɛ Kpɛe
44.english_title: Let The Lower lights Be Burning

verses.text:
Wa Tsɛ mɔbɔ nami ngɛ kpɛe
Kɛ je E kane we mi daa;
Se E kane ɔ kpɛmi ɔ E kɛ ha wɔ

44.chorus:
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kane nɛ tso,

DS Blɔ lalɔ ko ngɛ didae,

Kristofoli ta buli, nyɛ hia kɛ ya ta,

ɔ, Kɛ je blema nimli kɛ bɔfohi ngɛ lae.

45.chorus:
Klistofoli ta buli, nyɛ hia kɛ ya ta,

46.dangme_title: Te Si, Te Si Ha Yesu
46.english_title: Stand Up, Stand Up For Jesus

verses.text:
Te si, da si ha Yesu, bu titimati ɔ tue;

47.chorus:
Kpɛ kane ɔ, kpɛ kane ɔ

48.dangme_title: I Kɛ Ye He Kulaa Ha Yesu

verses.text:
I ngmɛɛ kulaa he kɛ ha Yesu,
       I wo kulaa kɛ ha yaka;
       Ma suɔ Lɛ nɛ ma kpasa Lɛ
       E hɛm' ma hi be fɛɛ be

I ngmɛɛ kulaa he kɛ ha Yesu,
       Ma kplasi ngɛ E nane nya,
       Je ɔ mi ngɔɔmi ɔmɛ I ngmɛɛ kulaa he,
       Wom' Yesu kɛ pee O nɔ.

I ngmɛɛ kulaa he kɛ ha Yesu,
Nyɔmtsɛ I wo ye he ha Mo.
Ha ma hyi kɛ O suɔmi he wam;
O jɔɔmi ɔ nɛ pue ye nɔ.

48.chorus:
I ngmɛɛ kulaa he, I ngmɛɛ kulaa he
       Kɛ ha Mo ye jɔɔmi Kpɔlɔ, I ngmɛɛ kulaa he.

49.dangme_title: Ngɔ Ye Wami Kɛ Pee O Nɔ
49.english_title: Take My life, And Let It Be

verses.text:
Ngɔɔ ye wami kɛ pee O nɔ
       Nɔ nɛ a jɔɔ nɔ ha Mo
       Wo ye ngmlɛfia kɛ ligbi
       Ha nɛ e pee O yi jem' sɔuu.

Wo ye nine kɛ tsu ni,
       Ngɛ O anɔkuale suɔmi he;
       Wo ye nane kɛ pee O nɔ
       E he sɔ nɛ hi fɛu ha Mo.

Wo ye gbi nɛ O ha ma la,
       Daa nɛ ɔ kɛ ha ye Matsɛ ɔ;
       Wo ye nya nɛ O ha nɛ
       E hyi fuu kɛ O munyu ɔ,

Wo ye sika hiɔ kɛ etsu ɔ,
       I kɛ huakpa be toe;
       Wo ye juɛmi kɛ tsu ni,
       Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ O kɛ ma tsu.

Wo ye suɔmi kɛ pee O nɔ,
       I kɛ be ye nɔ pee hu;
       Wo ye tsui, e ji O nɔ,
       Nɛ e pee matsɛ sɛ ha Mo.

Wo ye suɔmi ye Nyɔmtsɛ,
       I kɛ e juɛne ba O hɛ mi;
       Wo mi nɛ ma pee O nɔ,
       Mo pɛ O Nyɔmtsɛ ha Mo..

O nɔ jim' Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ I nu O gbi,
Nɛ e je O suɔm'  kpo ha mi,
Se I suɔ nɛ I kɛ hem'kɛ yem',
Ma sa kɛ ma su O he.

Nyɔmtsɛ, dla mi kɛ ha O ni tsumi,
       Ngɛ hiɔwe dloomi ɔ he wam';
       Ha nɛ ye susuma hyɛ kɛ hɛ nɔ kam'
       Nɛ ma pee O suɔm' nya ni.

Be kuku he blɔ nɛ I na bua jɔm',
       Kɛ ba O Matsɛ sɛ hɛm';
       Benɛ I kplasi ngɛ Ma'u hɛm' ngɛ kue fae,
       Wa sɛɛɔ ni kaa huɛ kɛ huɛ.

Suɔmi ko mi kuɔ nɛ I li lolo,
       Ja I po wo tokofii ɔ,
       Ngɔngɔɛ ko ngɛ nɛ I be nyɛɛ ma na,
       Ja I ba na he jɔm' ngɛ O mi.

50.chorus:
Gblaa mi kɛ ba jɔɔmi Nyɔmtsɛ
Sɛum' tso ɔ nɛ O gbo ngɛ nɔ ɔ hɛm';
Gblaa mi kɛ ba jɔɔmi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,
Kɛ su O plam' pa nɛ he jua wa he.

51.dangme_title: E Ngɔɔ Kaa Ma He Yesu Ye
51.english_title: T'is So Sweet To Trust In Jesus

verses.text:
E ngɔɔ kaa wa he Yesu ye,
Mo he E munyu ɔ ye kɛkɛ;
Kɛ o hɛ fɔ E si womi ɔ nɔ,
Le kɛkɛ ''Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ de'':

E ngɔɔ kaa mo he Yesu ye,
       He E muɔ ɔ nɛ tsuɔ nɔ he,
       Hem'kɛ yem' nɛ kɛ mi wo mi,
       E muɔ nɛ tsuɔ, nɛ tsaa nɔ.

Niinɛ e ngɔɔ, ma he Yesu ye,
       Ma kpa yayam' peem' kɛkɛ,
       Nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ je Yesu ngɔ,
       Wam', he jɔm', bua jɔm' tuem' jɔm'.

Ye bua jɔ kaa I he Lɛ nɛ I ye,
       Yesu, ye Nyɔmtsɛ, Huɛ kpakpa,
       Nɛ I le kaa O kɛ mi ngɛ,
       Wa maa hi si kɛ ya daa.

51.chorus:
Yesu, Yesu, I heɔ Mo yeɔƐ
I le bɔ  nɛ O ngɛ ha;
Yesu, Yesu, O he jua waƐ
O dloomi ɔ ha I heɔ yeɔ daa.

52.dangme_title: I Kɛ Mo Ngɛ Mawu Lee

verses.text:
I su O he Mawu lee, I su O he

       Ye la nɛ ma la pɛ ji,
       I saa su O he, Mawu lee,

       I saa su O he.

Ke I kɛ bua jɔm' ma te kɛ ya hiɔwe,

       Se ye la kɛkɛ ji ma su O ngɔ, Mawu lee.
       Ye Yesu, I Suɔ Mo

Ye Yesu I suɔ Mo, O nɔ ji mi,
       O he nɛ I kpa yayami ɔ nɛ I ngɛ pee;
       Ye Kpɔlɔ, dloomitsɛ, ye yi wam' helɔ ji Mo.
Nɔ Hlemi
       Ke e sa nɛ ma suɔ Mo ɔ, Yesu ma suɔ Mo daa.

Ngɔngɔɛ nɛ be nyagbe ngɛ anunyam' we mi,

Ma la kɛ pɛɛ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe nɛ I bu ngɛ ye yi nɔ.

54.dangme_title: A Jɔɔ Suɔm' Kpa Nɛ Fi Wɔ
54.english_title: Blest Be The Tie That Binds

verses.text:
A jɔɔ suɔmi kpa nɛ fi wɔ kaa Klistofohi,
       Nyɛmimɛ a huɛ bɔmi ngɛ kaa
       Bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɔwe.

Ngɛ wa Tsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi,
Wa kɛ wa kue fam' ba;
Wa gbeye, hɛ nɔ kam' kake,
Wa bua jɔm' kɛ aywilɛho.

Wɔ tsuaa wa dlaa haomihi,
Kɛ wɔ kulaa wa nɔ nam'
Nɛ wa foɔ ya kɛ ha wa bi
Kɛ mi mi sam' vo nyu.

Ke wa si wa sibi,
E dɔɔ wɔ ngɛ wa mi;
Se k0 ɔ ngɛ tsui mi
Wa ngɛ h0 n- kam',
Wa maa kpe ekohu.

Anunyam' h0 n- kam'
Kanyaa wɔ ngɛ blɔ nɔ;
Benɛ wa ngɛ wami nɛ ɔ mi,
Wa ngɛ ligbi ɔ mlɛe.

Kɛ je aywilɛho, pɔtɔ, dengme,
       Wa maa ye yayam' nɔ.
       Suɔmi nɛ ye emu kɛ huɛ bɔmi
       Hi si kɛ ya neneene.

55.dangme_title: Mo Ngɔ Yesu Biɛ Kɛ Fɔ O Nɔ
55.english_title: Take The Name Of Jesus With You

verses.text:
Mo ngɔ Yesu biɛ ɔ kɛ fɔ o nɔ,
       Aywilɛho kɛ nɔ nam' bi
       E maa ha mo bua jɔm', bua wom'
       Wo lɛ kɛ ya he fɛɛ he.

O Yesu biɛ he nɛ jua wa
E haa wa kla naa bua jɔm';
Ke E suɔm' nine wo wɔ,
Wa lilɛ ma la ha Lɛ.

Yesu biɛ mi wa ma kplasi,
Nɛ waa bu si ngɛ E hɛ mi,
Wa maa bu Lɛ matsɛhi akekle
Ke wa gbe blɔ hiami ɔ nya.

55.chorus:
Biɛ kpakpa, nɛ e ngɔɔ waa,
       Hɛ nɔ kam' kɛ hiɔwe bua jɔm',
       Biɛ kpakpa, e ngɔɔ wawɛɛ,
Hɛ nɔ kam' kɛ hiɔwe bua jɔm'Ɛ

verses.text:
Benɛ wami oslɔke kuɔ kɛ pue o nɔ,
Nɛ o ngɛ juɛɛ kaa hɛ nɔ kam' ko kulaa be hu,
Kane o jɔɔmihi babauu kakaaka,
Nɛ e maa pee mo nyakpɛ nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee.

Anɛ je mi sane ngɛ o nya gbae lo?

'o jɔɔmihi babauu, atsinye maa ya se, Nɛ 'o maa

Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke 'ye 'nɔkuale ngɛ gbenɔm',

Wa ma na Yesu nɛ ma ngɛ anunyam',

57.chorus:
Be ko maa ba nɛ wa ma le tsuo pɛ'
Be ko maa ba wa ma nu sisi,
Kanya o he anyɛmi nɛ o bua nɛ jɔɔ o he,

verses.text:
Mawu piɛ o he, wa ma kpe ekohu,

E kɛ E pɛli ngua a maa bu o nɔ,

Mawu piɛ o he wa maa kpe ekohu

Mawu piɛ o he wa maa kpe ekohu
Benɛ wami nyagba hlua mo,
E kɛ E nine ngua maa fua mo.
Mawu piɛ o he, wa maa kpe ekohu.

Mawu piɛ o he wa maa kpe ekohu,
E kɛ suɔm' flanga a ha o nɔ,
E maa fie gbenɔ gbeye ngɛ o he;
Mawu piɛ o he, wa maa kpe ekohu.

58.chorus:
Wa maa kpe ee, wa maa kpe ee,
Ekohu ngɛ Yesu nane nya,
Wa maa kpe ee, wa maa kpe ee
Mawu piɛɛ o he, wa maa kpe ekohu.

59.dangme_title: Wa Ma Bua Wa Nya Ngɛ Pa A Nya
59.english_title: Shall We Gather At The River

verses.text:
Wa ma bua wa he ngɛ pa a nya,
He nɛ bɔfohi nyɛɛ kɛ be ngɛ;
He nɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ ngɛ bee,
Ngɛ Mawu Matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛm'.

Wa maa bua wa nya ngɛ pa a tue,
Nɛ ngɛ sika hiɔ hwɔli fiae;
Wa maa nyɛɛ nɛ wa ma ja daa,
Hɛm'nyam' buajɔ ligbi ɔ tsuo.

Ke wa su pa nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ nya a,
Wa kɛ wa tlomi ma pue si;
Wa mumi ma yi kɛ dloomi,
Nɛ a ma ha wɔ jlasi kɛ tade.

E be kɛe wa ma su pa a nya,
Wa blɔ hiami ɔ maa ba nyagbe;
Wa bua jɔmi tsui maa jije,
Kɛ tuem' jɔmi la ngɔngɔɛ.

Ngɛ pa a nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ mi,
E je Nyɔmtsɛ hɛm' kpo ha wɔ;
He tsɔli nɛ gbenɔ yi a nɔ,
Wo a dloomi la gbi ɔ nɔ.

60.dangme_title: O Nyɔmtsɛ, Ha Nɛ I Kɛ Mo Nyɛɛ
60.english_title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee

verses.text:
O Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ I kɛ Mo nyɛɛ,
Nɛ ma kɛ he si bam' ja Mo;
De mi O lam' ni, ha mi he wam' ,
Kɛ da si ngɛ jem' nyagba mi.

Ha ye tsui nɛ gbɔjɔ kanya mi,
Kɛ gu O suɔmi munyu ɔ nɔ,
Tsɔɔ mi ko bɔlɔ ma fi si,
Nɛ kudɔ mi kɛ ya hiɔwe.

Mo tsɔɔ mi O tsui si tomi ɔ,
Nɛ I kɛ Mo hi huɛ bɔmi kpakpa;
Hem'kɛ yem' ni tsumi nɛ ngɔɔ
Nɛ yeɔ kunim' ngɛ yayami nɔ.

Hɛ nɔ kami nɛ ngɛ kpɛe,
Kɛ ha hwɔ se blɔ gbajaa a nɔ,
Tuem' jɔm' nɛ je Mo pɛ O ngɔ;
I kɛ Mo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma hi si.

61.english_title: Dear Lord And Father Of Mankind

verses.text:
Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ adesa Tsaatsɛ,
Kɛ wa biɛmi ke wɔ;
Ha wɔ juɛmi kpakpa,
Nɛ wa kɛ he tsɔmi nɛ ja Mo,
Nɛ wa kɛ bumi je O yi.

Hemi kɛ yem' kaa nihi nɛ bu tue
Ngɛ Syria wo ɔ nya;
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ E dloomi tsɛ mi,
Kaa mɛ, wɔ hu, nya jem' ko be ha wɔ
Te si nɛ nyɛɛ O se

O he jɔɔmi ngɛ Galelia
Kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɔwe,
He nɛ Yesu kpla si ngɛ
Nɛ E sɛ neneene dii peemi;
Enɛ ɔ kulaa tsɔɔ suɔmi..

Mo ha nɛ O bɔ nɛ nɛ ha wɔ,
Kɛ ya dengme nyagbe.
Je wa kla kɛ je dengme dɛm',
Nɛ wa jem' bam' kpakpa
Ye O tuem' he jɔmi he odase. Amen

Benɛ ye blɔ nɔ pee kpii, su ye he Nyɔmtsɛ,
Benɛ ye wami nya ngɛ tae;
Bu mi tue kɛ ye ngmla, pɛtɛ ye he ma ko nɔ si,
Ta ye dɛm' Nyɔmtsɛ kpakpa kɛ ya wem'.

Benɛ nini maa ba, nɛ gbɔkuɛ ngɛ sue,
Nɛ je nam' be kɛ ho;
I daa si ngɛ pa a nya, tsɔɔ mi blɔ,
Pɛt  ɛ ye he, ta ye dɛm' Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ hi kɛ mi ya
wem'.

62.chorus:
Ta ye dɛm' Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ hi, nyɛɛ ye hɛm' nɛ ma da si,
Pɔtɔ ye he, I gbɔjɔ, I gbede, kɛ gu ahum',
Kɛ nyɔ mi; nyɛɛ ye hɛm' kɛ kane ɔ,
Ta ye dɛm', Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ hi kɛ ya wem'.

63.dangme_title: Mo Gba Mi Yesu He Sane
63.english_title: Tell Me The Story Of Jesus

verses.text:
E ni kake ngɛ hwɔ hae ngɛ ngam',
Gbaa mi be ɔmɛ nɛ a be;
Wa yayam' he nɛ a ka Lɛ,
Se E ye kunim' ngɛ nyagbe.
Gbaa mi bɔ nɛ E ba gbo dengme,
Kɛ aywilɛho nɛ ba tloo Lɛ:
A pla Lɛ nɛ a pue E hɛm' si,
E be we, nɛ a kua Lɛ, nɛ e hia Lɛ.

Gbaa mi bɔ nɛ a sɛu Lɛ ha,
Nɛ E ngɛ kɛmɛɛ ngɛ yeye mi;
Gbaa mi he nɛ a pu Lɛ ngɛ,
Gbaa mi bɔ nɛ E te si ekohu.
Munyu nɛ ɔ mi suɔmi he hia,
Nɛ je kpo paa nɛ I na;
Benɛ I ngɛ ya foe, O de ke:
Suɔmi nɛ wo ye hiɔ ha mi.

63.chorus:
Mo gba mi Yesu sane,
Nɛ O ngma munyu ɔ ngɛ ye tsui mi;
Gba mi sane ɔ nɛ he jua wa,
Nɛ ngɔɔ wawɛɛ ke a nu.

64.dangme_title: Piɔ Nɛ Ɔ, ligbi Ɔ Ba Nyagbe

verses.text:
Mwɔnɛ ligbi ɔ nya ta,
Du hu ngɛ bue;
Gbɔkuɛ nini ngɛ bee
Kɛ ha bɔ kuu hɛm'.

Nihi nɛ a gbede ɔ Yesu ha
He jɔɔm' kɛ ngɔngɔɛ,
Kɛ O jɔɔm' saminya
Ha wa hwɔ mahɛ.

Ha nɛ jukuɛ tsɔwi
Na O kane gbongaa;
Bu wo yali nɛ a
Yi fi ngɛ wo gbaja a nɔ.

Wo nɔ nali tsuaa a bua,
Nɛ a ngɛ dengme gboe;
Nihi nɛ a susu yayam'
Tsake a juɛmi.

Ke je na hɛ mi tsɔ
Imi hu ma te si.
Nɛ yayam' ko be ye he
Ngɛ O hɛ mi klɔuu. Amen

65.dangme_title: Nyɔmtsɛ Wa Ba O Hɛ Mi Piɔ
65.english_title: Lord, We Come Before Thee Now

verses.text:
Nyɔmtsɛ, wa kla ngɛ O nɔ,

''O tsɛ we E biɛ kɛ ha imi.''

259.dangme_title: MƐNƆ DAASI NGƐ SINYA A NYA?

verses.text:

Kɛ tsui nam' ngɛ wa he sue,
Nɛ ngɛ bie nɛ ma sɛ tsu ɔ mi?
Mɛnɔ gbi nɛ I ngɛ nue?

E kpale ngɛ sinya sie
Yesu, anɛ pɔ tuɛ O he lo

I ngɛ esɔ hee kɛ ha Mo,
Nɛ ma bli ye tsui gbajaa
Ke E ka ye hɛm' tete po ɔ,
E kɛ mi ma hi si.
